$comment: Release self-declaration consumed by the unified registry's auto-core-release resolver (sh2-plugin-registry/scripts/resolve-core-candidate.mjs) at the git tag being released, and by this repo's release-descriptor step. supports.core is the semver range of core (backend) versions this frontend works with; while the platform is pre-1.0, every 0.x minor is breaking, so widen/bump it deliberately. Raise the lower bound whenever a frontend feature starts depending on a newer backend feature (e.g. a new/changed /cms-api endpoint): the floor 0.1.15 is the core release that ships the style-schema contract this frontend depends on - the mobile-rendering taxonomy (style `renderTarget`, required field `scope` driving inspector grouping, the shared_/web_ field split with `pages.id_platform` removed in favour of the page access type) PLUS the alert/badge/avatar/button/login authoring-polish field set this frontend now reads (alert `closable`; button/badge `shared_variant`; badge `circle`; avatar `name`; login `subtitle`), all part of the same unreleased 0.1.15 schema, so an incompatible frontend+backend pair can never be auto-assembled into a release.
